bias_targets.methodology: Applying a joint image-text fusion model to New York Times article images to predict and compare moral sentiment and moral foundation scores across different regional news categories (e.g., US, Europe, Asia, Africa, Middle East).

Using a trained visual moral inference model to estimate and compare the relevance of different moral foundations (Care, Fairness, Ingroup, Authority, Purity) across various news categories (e.g., health, sports, business, science, technology).
